title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 506  An Act Converting the Panay Barangay High School in the Municipality of Panay, Province of Capiz, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Commissioner Luis Asis National High School, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds

title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Panay Barangay tại Thị trấn Panay, Tỉnh Capiz thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Commissioner Luis Asis Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Panay Barangay ในเทศบาล Panay จังหวัด Capiz เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Commissioner Luis Asis แห่งชาติ

text.en:
The Panay Barangay High School in the Municipality of Panay, Province of Capiz, is converted
into a national high school to be known as the Commissioner Luis Asis National High School.

The amount of one hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be funded out of
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 230 for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Sports
intended for new national high schools and an additional amount corresponding to fifty percent of its share in
the budgetary aid actually paid to it before such conversion shall be released for its operation from the
national assistance fund to local schools. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for its operation and
maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1983
